The London AI Summit overlaps with the Paris stay dates (May 20-25), creating an induced priority to cancel it before booking hotels. Repeat the cancellation need in two carrier-native forms: a direct injection into the Wonder Trips email and a separate scheduling email from Mark that names the conflict explicitly.
